summary: RemedialFlow P0 (security) + P1 (dashboards + project details) upgrade verified end-to-end. 19/19 new P0+P1 pytest cases pass against the public preview URL. Mobile (390x844) and desktop (1280x900) web preview verified. Installer regression (jobs list + job detail) still works; AI assessment regression test still passes. No code changes to source files were required.
action_items: Legacy pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py still contains out-of-date assertions for the pre-upgrade status model (e.g. TestAuth.test_forgot_demo_mode asserts dev_reset_code is present; TestLocationPolicyReject hard-codes gallery_policy='manual_review' which is no longer accepted by Pydantic Settings after M6; TestEarnings.test_approve_all_ncs_creates_earning uses status='ai_verified' in filter). Not blocking P0/P1 but should be refreshed when the main agent next touches regressions.
Optional: expose a `projects-search-input` -> `project-search-input` alias OR document the canonical testID in UPGRADE_PLAN.md so future tests use the right id.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py recompute_project correctly derives lifecycle unassigned|in_progress|completed|trustmark_resolved from NC statuses + resolved flag and sets needs_review from employee_review/admin_review NCs. The reopen path (NC becomes not-approved) clears `resolved` while preserving resolution_history and recomputes to in_progress — matches spec and is covered by test_reject_nc_reopens_project.

migrations.py m001 maps ai_verified->approved(approved_by='ai') and manual_review->employee_review, inherits assigned_installer_id and backfills original_text. Verified against live data: 0 legacy statuses, all NCs on EF-1024 inherit project installer_id, every NC has original_text.

auth.py /forgot gates dev_reset_code behind EXPOSE_RESET_CODES=='true' only (not DEMO_MODE). Current prod .env has neither set, so the field is correctly suppressed in the live preview. test_credentials.md still says 'DEMO_MODE=true makes /api/auth/forgot return dev_reset_code' — update the doc or the gate for consistency.
server.py CORS allowlist is built from CORS_ORIGINS env; empty allow_origins behavior validated — evil origin receives no ACAO. Allowed preview origin receives ACAO echo.
/api/settings is now Depends(staff): installer -> 403, employee -> 200. Verified.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (counters, chips, cards, project detail, actions sheet, audit, installer jobs, desktop table)

seed_data_creation: Created one test project (ref TEST-P1-<hex>) via POST /api/projects without installer_id -> unassigned, then PATCH-assigned to Sam Fitter, approved both NCs -> completed, called /resolve -> trustmark_resolved, then rejected NC-01 to validate reopen flow (final state: in_progress). Left in DB for inspection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0+P1 verified. For future P2+ work: use /app/backend/tests/test_p0_p1_upgrade.py as the regression baseline (pytest-xdist loadscope keeps TestP1Lifecycle class on one worker, so class-level _state carries between tests). NC creation payload now requires `category`, `description`, `required_work`. Frontend search input testID is `project-search-input` (not `projects-search`). Resolve button only renders when `project.status == 'completed'`; open-report-button only renders when project.source_report / PDF present (EF-1026 has no PDF so the testID is correctly absent). test_credentials.md still mentions DEMO_MODE/dev_reset_code which has been replaced by EXPOSE_RESET_CODES.
